response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: AVG and SUM ignore NULLs by default; a group whose rebtotal values are all NULL yields a NULL total_rebate and is sorted last (SQLite 3.30+ supports NULLS LAST; NULLs are otherwise ordered first in ASC, so last in DESC anyway).
If several orders share the same recordvault, the join duplicates fee rows per matching order; recordvault is described as a unique order reference, so this is assumed not to occur.
